commission.title: Judicial Commission of Inquiry into Criminality, Political Interference and Corruption in the Criminal Justice System

claims.statement: The Commission was established by Presidential Proclamation 269 in Gazette 53048 on 23 July 2025.
Justice Mbuyiseli Madlanga is the chairperson and Sesi Baloyi SC and Sandile Khumalo SC are commissioners.
The Commission's mandate concerns alleged criminality, political interference and corruption in the criminal justice system.
The Presidency announced on 19 September 2026 that the final report deadline is 25 January 2027.
The public archive records Day 178 on 23 September 2026 as the latest sitting represented here.

agentRoles.name: Chair Agent
agentRoles.mission: Test scope, procedure and evidence sufficiency without issuing findings.

agentRoles.name: Evidence Agent
agentRoles.mission: Build claim-to-source provenance and identify missing primary evidence.

agentRoles.name: Chronology Agent
agentRoles.mission: Normalize dated events and expose sequence gaps without inferring causation.

agentRoles.name: Contradiction Agent
agentRoles.mission: Identify incompatible records or testimony and preserve both sides.

agentRoles.name: Network Agent
agentRoles.mission: Map source-supported relationships between people, institutions and events.

agentRoles.name: Verification Agent
agentRoles.mission: Challenge material claims and test source quality.

agentRoles.name: Research Agent
agentRoles.mission: Locate relevant public records and return provenance, not unsupported synthesis.

agentRoles.name: Docket Agent
agentRoles.mission: Track procedural state, filings and hearing records without inventing events.

agentRoles.name: Red-Team Agent
agentRoles.mission: Attack proposed synthesis for missing evidence, ambiguity and classification errors.
